title: White Chicken Chilli
ingredients: 600g (1lb 5oz) chicken thigh fillets (about 6), fat trimmed away
2 green chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
2 x 400g (14oz) cans of cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
TO SERVE: coriander leaves, sliced green chillies, lime wedges
method: Place the chicken, onion, chillies, cannellini beans, sweetcorn, garlic granules, cumin, oregano and chicken stock into the slow-cooker pot and season with salt and pepper.
Give everything a mix, pop the lid on and cook on high for 4-5 hours, or on low for 7-8 hours.
Towards the end of the cooking time, in a small bowl, combine the crème fraîche and cornflour.
Use 2 forks to shred the chicken thighs in the slow-cooker bowl, then stir in the crème fraîche mixture. Leave for 5 minutes, then stir again.
Serve with coriander leaves, sliced green chillies and a lime wedge.
notes: Serve with baked potatoes, tortilla chips, guacamole, sliced avocado, grated cheese, jalapeños and lime wedges, or with rice. Oven method: 180°C/160°C fan, Gas Mark 4, casserole with lid, 1 hour 20 minutes.
